name: Mixed Acid Etchant (MAE Series)
description: Mixed Acid Etchant (MAE Series) is a family of proprietary multi-component acid etchant formulations for semiconductor and flat panel display manufacturing. The MAE series is designed for specialized etching applications where standard single- or dual-acid etchants do not provide the required selectivity, etch rate, or surface finish. Each MAE formulation is optimized for specific material systems and device integration requirements. Applications include multi-layer metal stack etching, compound semiconductor processing, and specialty thin film patterning. Custom formulations and process optimization support are available to meet specific customer requirements.
physicalProperties: Appearance: clear to colored liquid (varies by formulation); Contact supplier for detailed specifications
